summary: End-to-end validation of PrestaShop categories sync flow after 'Borrar contenido sincronizado' and resync. Backend endpoints, DB persistence, and UI rendering all verified working. Categories now appear correctly in Configuración → Categorías with auto-expanded hierarchy.
passed: DELETE /api/integrations/prestashop/{integration_id}/clear-data -> 200 success, removed 131 prestashop_categories, 0 local_categories (manual preserved)
POST /api/integrations/prestashop/{integration_id}/sync-categories -> 200, synced_count=131, message '131 categorías sincronizadas exitosamente'
DB after resync: categories collection contains 126 docs (122 source=prestashop + 4 source=manual); prestashop_categories collection has 131
Prestashop categories have correct integration_id, store_id, prestashop_id, parent_id, level fields
GET /api/categories -> 200 returns 126 items (122 prestashop + 4 manual); roots include 'Raíz' (prestashop) and 'T1' (manual)
Frontend login -> Configuración -> Categorías tab renders CategoryTree with hierarchical prestashop categories

Auto-expand works: console shows 'Auto-expandiendo 4 nodos (raíces + segundo nivel)' and UI shows 'Raíz' + 'Toda la Tienda' expanded, exposing Dropship, Grow Shop, Home & Garden, Lifestyle, Liquidación Verano, etc.
Frontend console: 'Categorías cargadas: 126 total (Tienda 1: 122, manual: 4)' confirming data reaches the component
Manual categories (T1, Cat Sub, Sub 2, Sub 3) NOT deleted by clear-data (source=manual preserved)
